title: improvement: add _Static_assert coupling CBOR DoS guard to keystore limits
description: wp11_keystore.c:437-450 guards against CBOR DoS by rejecting maps with more than WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_CT_LEN/2 pairs. This limit is tightly coupled to WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_ENTRIES: if someone increases MAX_ENTRIES without adjusting the guard, a malicious file can trigger excessive iteration. Add: _Static_assert(WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_ENTRIES * 2 <= WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_CT_LEN / 2, "CBOR DoS guard must be updated when MAX_ENTRIES changes"); Add a comment explaining the derivation next to both constants.
